blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — GCash operator Mynt Inc.’s early stock market slump has made its shares more attractive, but stronger earnings could be needed to drive a recovery, according to COL Financial chief equity strategist April Lee-Tan. Tan said the company’s fundamentals remained strong despite the pullback, pointing to COL’s P8-per-share target price in its initiating coverage […]...
